author: Nego
text:
Hi to all of you.

I've been carefully going through some the posts, threads and journals
here at RTM in the past few weeks and I just wanted to drop a quick
thank you.

Thx to you IF, I can tell that you invested blood, sweat and tears into
RTM. I am sure that your efforts will pay off soon, and that joy,
happyness and personal satisfaction (both mentally and financially) will
 outweigh big times the sacrifices that you took here.

Also, thx to the community! Together we shape a bunch of elite retail
traders that combines its brain power to read and negotiate the markets.
 I am grateful to be part of this community and I'd like to get involved
 more and more.

I've seen some impressive trades here, very nice.

Have a nice day all

Edit: I'm a full time (demo ) trader and I'd like to get in touch with others. Please PM me to share email and skype, etc.

author: Ifmyante
text:

text:

If you don't mind it, maybe you can help me out with this one:

author: Ifmyante
text:
The trade opps that slap you in the face will only do so once you've reached a proper understanding of price.

Until then, you won't notice them at all :)

author: Ifmyante
text:
A student flew over from Prague to meet me yesterday. I'm deeply honoured you did this, V :)

One thing that struck me about our conversation was that he told me he
has studied every part of RTM, but he has studied them all separately.

Let me reply to everybody here what I shall tell my visitor later today:

RTM is not a set of pictures to be studied. It is a jigsaw puzzle.

It will only make perfect sense when all the pieces have been fitted together correctly.

You need look nowhere else for the pieces of the puzzle; they're all here. But RTM is a test nonetheless.

Put the puzzle together and you'll SEE the market as clearly as you see the screen before you :)

I want each and every one of you to succeed, but I want you to earn your success.

Renew your efforts, and don't let anything stop you

Best

If
